# Neolytix

> Neolytix is a healthcare operations and revenue cycle management (RCM) specialist providing comprehensive services including medical billing, credentialing, provider enrollment, and practice optimization for healthcare providers across the USA.

Neolytix operates as a Management Service Organization (MSO) with offices in Chicago, Gurugram (India), and the Philippines. The company leverages its inCredibly platform and data-driven workflows to help healthcare providers reduce denials, accelerate reimbursements, and optimize operations while maintaining HIPAA and compliance standards.

## Key Topics

- Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
- Medical Billing & Coding
- Healthcare Credentialing
- Provider Enrollment
- HIPAA Compliance
- Medical Licensing
- Patient Access Services

- CVO (Credentialing Verification Organization)

## Core Services

- [Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management Services](https://neolytix.com/revenue-cycle-management): RCM services reducing denials and accelerating reimbursements with data-driven workflows
- [CVO Credentialing Services (NCQA-Ready)](https://neolytix.com/credentialing-verification-organization): NCQA-ready CVO credentialing with primary source verification and sanction monitoring
- [Provider Enrollment Services](https://neolytix.com/provider-enrollment-services): Provider enrollment services via inCredibly platform for PECOS and CAQH enrollment
- [Patient Access Services](https://neolytix.com/patient-access-services): Enterprise patient access services for scheduling, eligibility, and prior authorization
- [Medical Coding Audit Services & Training](https://neolytix.com/medical-coding-audit-services): Medical coding audit services with post-audit training for compliance and accuracy
- [Medical Licensing Services](https://neolytix.com/medical-licensing-services): Multi-state, telehealth, DEA, and CLIA-compliant medical licensing services
- [Healthcare Accounting Services](https://neolytix.com/healthcare-accounting): HIPAA-compliant healthcare accounting and financial management for providers

## Technology & Platforms

- [inCredibly - Medical Credentialing Software](https://neolytix.com/credentialing-verification-organization/incredibly): inCredibly: Automated credentialing software for provider enrollment and compliance
- [Revenue Transformation Program](https://neolytix.com/revenue-transformation): Revenue transformation program with leakage analysis and coding audits for providers

## Business Models

- [MSO (Management Service Organization)](https://neolytix.com/mso): MSO model for medical and dental practice growth and management in Chicago and USA
